title: Dev M and RC2 AAPS Client missing BG's and regular updates
body:
Tested with Dev M and RC2 and both aaps clients will miss BG updates. All power savings are turned off.. nothing is killing the app. 
Can get updates if i pause websockets for a moment then restart and the data will refresh. 
Regular updates are occurring in NSClient though

[AndroidAPS_LOG_1696874984171.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/12849197/AndroidAPS_LOG_1696874984171.log.zip)
[AndroidAPS_LOG_1696874984171.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/12849201/AndroidAPS_LOG_1696874984171.log.zip)

@MilosKozak improvements yes.. I can see everything except for BG update now
Is NS updated to latest dev? AAPSClient and AAPS? Im feeding AAPS with bg from xdrip and i dont have issues after update yet in AAPS, AAPSClient or NS with sync.

Yes both with latest dev.. I'm using BYOD for BG.. aaps syncs perfectly.. aapsclient will sync then lose bg but gets basal and carbs and smb etc. It'll also send from aapsclient for carbs temp targets etc. Just the BG won't show up unless you pause and restart the connection
Strange. I know what Milos would say;  Create new issue and attach logs :) Just make sure that Nightscout is latest dev also and that AAPSclient and AAPS use same API version (stating the obvious) ;)
